Optuna is an automatic hyperparameter optimization software framework.
Tokyo is the capital of Japan and one of the largest cities in the world.
Tenacity is a Python library for adding retry behavior to function calls.
Pandas is a Python library for data manipulation and analysis.

Mount Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan, standing at 3776 meters.
The Nile is the longest river in the world, flowing through northeastern Africa.
